title: Late Charge Share for Members in Good Standing on Farm Real Estate Loans — Operating Lines of Credit
content:
A member's standing on Farm Real Estate Loans with the association sets the share of a late charge the member is charged on the Operating Lines of Credit.

## Rule

The member is charged:

- **0.75 of the figure** when the member holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status with no billed interest unpaid on it;
- **0.9 of the figure** when the member holds no Farm Real Estate loan in active status but holds one paid off;
- **the whole figure** in every other case.

The figure is the charge base multiplied by the late charge percentage. The share acts on that figure before it is rounded to cents and before the minimum and maximum late charge are applied. The status of each farmland loan and the billed interest unpaid on it are read from the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records.

## Truth table

| Farm Real Estate loan in active status | Billed interest unpaid on that loan | A Farm Real Estate loan paid off | Share charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Held | None | Any | 0.75 |
| Held | Some | Any | Whole |
| None | — | Yes | 0.9 |
| None | — | No | Whole |

## Illustration (hypothetical figure of USD 200.00 before rounding and limits)

A member whose active FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage has nothing billed and unpaid is charged on 0.75 of USD 200.00, that is USD 150.00; a member whose only farmland mortgage is paid off is charged on USD 180.00; a member with billed interest unpaid on an active farmland mortgage is charged on the whole USD 200.00.
